description.value: The Westridge Motor Inn is a fully renovated 32-room motel sitting at the junction of Highway 3 (Crowsnest Highway) and Highway 97 in Osoyoos, at the heart of Canada's warmest desert. It offers a range of room types from courtyard queens to king suites with new Serta mattresses, kitchenettes in all suites, and a seasonal outdoor pool and BBQ patio. Located directly across from the Osoyoos Visitor Information Centre, it is a natural stop for cyclists riding the Crowsnest route through the South Okanagan wine country.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM phone number and email. The /motel-information page explicitly confirms complimentary guest laundry; the /room-information page and OSM internet_access=wlan both confirm free Wi-Fi throughout the property. No mention of bike storage, bike-specific procedures, or cyclist amenities appears anywhere on the site. A postal code discrepancy exists within the website itself (footer shows V0R 1V2; contact and address pages show V0H 1V2 — the correct code for Osoyoos is V0H 1V2).
concerns: Postal code discrepancy within the website itself: footer widget consistently shows V0R 1V2 while the contact page and address blocks show V0H 1V2. V0H 1V2 is the correct Canada Post postal code for Osoyoos and has been used as the canonical address here.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating motel on the Crowsnest Highway cycling corridor in Osoyoos with a live booking system and full website.

Laundry.detail: Complimentary guest laundry available for all guests, per /motel-information page
